name: Dark Thaumaturgical Rituals — 1 Basic — Bind the Interloper

system.description: Allows an infernalist who knows a demon's True Name and its current master to steal the demon's loyalty. After a casting time based on the demon's Willpower Traits, the caster must defeat the demon's current master in a Mental Challenge to transfer its service; failure costs three Willpower Traits and reveals the caster's face to the rival.
system.duration: Remainder of the demon's term of service
